title: Expedition to Najd (1817–1818)
text: The Najd Expedition was a multi-battle campaign waged by Ottoman Egypt from 1817 to 1818. It was part of Third Campaign of the Ottoman–Wahhabi War of 1811 to 1818, which was the final campaign on the war. It was commanded by Ibrahim Pasha, son of Egyptian ruler Muhammad Ali Pasha, by order of Ottoman Sultan Mahmud II. The goal was to end the Emirate of Diriyah and capture the capital city of Diriyah, through no real strategy other than brute force.
